title: Chapter 400 Who Is Your Master
content:
Chapter 400 Who Is Your Master

Old man Broken Sword!

A long time ago memory.

The old man Broken Sword's face was also slightly surprised. He didn't expect that Ao Qing would remember him.

In the past, Ao Qing first came to the deserted city, and wanted to break in. At that time, the old man Broken Sword was the first to stand out.

Of course, with the strength of the old man Broken Sword at that time, he couldn't even slow down Ao Qing.

So the old man Broken Sword was a little surprised that Ao Qing could remember himself.

However, after being surprised, the old man Broken Sword quickly smiled again, and then respectfully saluted Lu Xue, "Miss Lu, if there was no desert city back then, there would be no me now. Your family, be kind to me. It's as heavy as a mountain."

Since entering the deserted city, the old man Broken Sword has relied on rich resources to continuously improve his strength.

But soon, he realized that it didn't seem to make any sense.

Because the progress of Huangcheng is really fast.

The guys in the City Lord’s Mansion were like monsters. No matter how hard they tried, they were still unattainable to face them.

Finally, after careful consideration, after saying goodbye to some friends, the old man Broken Sword left the deserted city and resolutely embarked on his journey.

Along the way, he has experienced many adventures and turned bad luck into good fortune many times, and has also made a great reputation.

Then, relying on the passage left by the deserted city on the other side of the starry sky, we came to the current Chaos Realm.

The purpose is to reach the giant city hanging high in the sky.

At that moment, the old man Broken Sword knew that it was time for him to take a break.

"I was surprised to see you here, to be honest."

Looking at the old man Broken Sword with a pious expression in front of him, Lu Xue nodded.

Although the old man Broken Sword's aura was restrained, Lu Xue could still vaguely feel the strong killing aura in his body.

That is not something you can have in a stable life in the city.

It seems that this senior has experienced a lot over the years.

"It just so happens that I am also preparing to go back to the deserted city. Why don't I go together?"

Lu Xue continued.

Hearing this, the old man Broken Sword smiled slightly, "Then it's better to obey your orders than respect."

It just so happened that he hadn't been back for a long time.

I don't know how those guys are doing now.

Although the area where the two are located is also a human territory, the human territory is too large, and this is just a remote area.

This is also the reason why the people here don’t even know that the treasure of the human race is Xuanyuan Sword.

"Miss Lu, seeing you like this, it seems that you haven't been back for a long time."

Walking on the road, the old man Broken Sword began to speak.

Lu Xue did not hide this and nodded, "Since my father left, I have been in the Human Emperor Palace for a while and left the Chaos Realm."

Speaking of this, Lu Xue's eyes were a little more complicated.

"I have to say that the outside world is really wonderful."

The old man Broken Sword on the side nodded unconsciously. Of course, he agreed with this sentence, after all, he had been outside for a long time.

"I have gone to many places and felt many different cultivation systems. Although I have achieved the same goal, I have gained a lot."

"Then why are you coming back suddenly?"

asked the old man Broken Sword.

When he came back, Lu Xue had just returned shortly.

Lu Xue smiled at the question of the old man Broken Sword. She slowly looked up at the sky and said softly: "I feel that Dad is coming back."

Lu Daosheng.

Lord of the Wilderness City!

Hearing this sentence, the old man Broken Sword couldn't help but feel a silence and his whole body was trembling. It was caused by excitement.

"The Lord of the City,"

"It's soon."

The city was very small, and the two left the place after walking a few steps.

The Chaos Realm is now thriving. Since the fall of the Gods, only three of the six powerful clans were left.

The Shadow Clan collectively joined the human race, and the Heavenly Demon Clan and the Holy Spirit Clan also joined the human race, and the human race became the only one in the Chaos Realm.

After so many years of development, the human race has completely become the overlord of the Chaos Realm.

Whether it is resources, talents, or strong people, the human race is far superior to the other races.

Against this celestial background, the human race has become increasingly inflated, which has led to the other races being exploited by the human race and suffering.

"Miss Lu, are we going the wrong way? It seems that we are not going to Huangcheng in this direction."

The old man Broken Sword looked back at the deserted city behind him and scratched his head in confusion.

"Senior Jian, don't be impatient. Huangcheng will definitely go, but before I go back, I will deal with something."

Lu Xue said calmly.

Upon hearing this, the old man Broken Sword said nothing and continued to follow silently.

Ao Qing in Lu Xue's sleeve came out and lay on Lu Xue's shoulder.

"My master, I'm sorry to trouble you this time."

Ao Qing sighed a little, and his bright dragon eyes were a little disappointed at this moment.

Lu Xue reached out and touched Ao Qing's head, comforting him, "It's okay, after all, it's expected that the human race will expand after too long."

"But, you can't bully other races everywhere."

Just a while ago, Ao Qing received news from the Tiande Clan.

The harshness of the human race against the Heavenly Demon Clan has caused complaints within the clan, and many monsters are very dissatisfied with the human race.

In desperation, they found Ao Qing.

Ao Qing accepted the inheritance of their Heavenly Demon Clan back then. In a sense, Ao Qing was responsible for the Heavenly Demon Clan.

Faced with the Tian Yao Clan's request for help, Ao Qing naturally would not sit idly by.

And this kind of bullying is definitely not just happening in the Heavenly Demon Clan.

Just as the two of them continued to move forward, a fierce vibration suddenly came from the distance.

Looking up, a huge frame ran from a distance.

In front of the frame were two huge wolf demons, with light blue flames burning all over their bodies.

Blue Flame Wolf King.

The monsters of the Heavenly Demon Clan have a not low status.

But at this moment, the two blue-faced wolf kings could only become slaves to pull the cart in humiliation.

Thumb!

The sound of stepping on the void came, and the huge frame immediately stopped in front of Lu Xue and the others.

Looking closely, the frame is made of rare materials, and it is full of strange light.

This is definitely from some big force.

The old man Broken Sword's expression remained unchanged, and he thought to himself.

At this time, the frame slowly opened and an old man with a steady breath slowly walked out of it.

He was dressed in gorgeous clothes and sharp eyes, staring at Lu Xue and the others below.

To be precise, it was staring at Lu Xue.

"This girl, my master wants to invite you to the car for a talk."

The old man said calmly.

Hearing this, the old man Broken Sword suddenly frowned slightly.

"Your master? Who is your master?"

"I'm talking to this girl, don't interrupt if you are idle."

The old man's tone was unquestionable, which made the old man Duanjian look even worse and worse, and the broken sword on his waist began to tremble slightly.
